The test expects the final integration time to match the specified end time within a certain tolerance.

To diagnose the issue further, we need to examine the implementation of the `integrate` method in `DormandPrince853Integrator` to understand how the termination conditions, particularly the end event handling, are managed. This investigation will help identify any inconsistencies or errors in handling the specified end time for the integration.
